question: Within species sharing the same exact anthocyanidin-presence class, is the gene-expression phylogenetic distance association retained after accounting for the measured continuous pigment concentration profile?

source.source_identity: Use frozen SHA-256 values for phyloCCA table, tree and R source; no alternative source

frame.cohort_rule: Inherit exactly the previously frozen >=5 observations per six-bit fine-state filter; no recovery or alteration of the 12 excluded taxa

covariate_adjustment.transformation: For each 47-species numeric pigment column apply log1p(100 * mg/g), population z-score across 47 species; assign zero to zero-variance columns, never outcome-select columns
covariate_adjustment.fixed_effects: Six nonoverlapping exact six-bit pigment-presence class dummies, no intercept; regress 21 gene-expression vectors simultaneously on those 6 dummies and all 9 fixed pigment columns using Moore-Penrose pseudo-inverse rcond=1e-12
covariate_adjustment.expression_transform: The exact same 21 prespecified gene TPM10K values as the prior primary analysis, log1p and population z-score across 47 tips
covariate_adjustment.projection: M=I−D@pinv(D), where D contains frozen state dummies and pigment covariates; residual gene-expression matrix R=M@expression

test.pair_universe: 183 unordered pairs of the 47 retained taxa sharing the exact same six-bit pigment-presence class
test.predictor: Negative? No: positive patristic distance on published source tree
test.outcome: RMS Euclidean distance between each pair's residual 21-gene expression vector
test.estimator: Spearman rho of patristic distances vs residual expression RMS across the frozen 183 pairs
test.null: Freedman–Lane-style constrained within-exact-class whole-21-gene-residual-vector permutation; for each permutation P, generate projected residual Rb=M@P@R; recompute 183-pair RMS and Spearman rho. Whole vectors preserve across-gene covariance. Classes and tree/pigment covariates remain fixed.
test.permutation_unit: Taxon-level 21-gene residual vector within each exact pigment-presence state; species-pair observations are dependent and are never inferential replicates
test.decision: RETROSPECTIVE_SUPPORT if observed rho > mean null rho AND upper-tail (1 + #null>=observed)/10000 <=0.05; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED
test.interpretation: Tests whether gene-expression residual structure is associated with ancestry beyond linear source pigment abundance profiles and fine-state fixed effects, under an approximate residual-exchangeability permutation null; DOES NOT ESTABLISH causal independence, molecular architecture or adaptation

robustness.leave_one_species_out: Descriptive: re-fit pigment nuisance and recalculate rank correlation on the remaining 46 retained tips, 47 times; no new P-values, no threshold changes
robustness.output_diagnostics: Matrix rank of nuisance covariates, number of zero-variance pigment assays, original rho and residual rho, null mean/quantiles, observed P, residual variance fraction
guardrails: No alternate pigment subsets after results
No alternate state codings or rare-state cutoff changes
No post-hoc switching from residualization to partial Mantel as primary
No claim about taxa excluded by frozen filter

evidence_status: Retrospective one-radiation, post-source-exposure. Specific new statistic frozen before opening it, not a prospectively independent biological validation.
